title: Shader grid slot-12 notification
summary: Recover the x86 thiscall traversal at 0x52f560: 280 columns, six rows at offset 0xe1c and stride 0x460; call vtable +0x0c on each non-null entry, retaining live reads and aliases.
test_description: Compare original and recovered calls for empty, corner-only, fully populated, sparse aliased and callback-mutated grids. Compare complete ordered callback logs, per-object call counters and guards, entire fixture bytes, prefix and trailing canaries. Check 32-bit field layout and row stride.
known_limits: Slot operation, original class/member names and full manager layout remain unresolved.
Valid objects and callable slot-12 vtables are required; invalid pointer faults and throwing callbacks are outside tests.
Original layout is 32-bit; pointer layout changes on 64-bit builds require integration work.
Callbacks use controlled test objects; no rendering or OS internals are validated.
